activities.title: Listen to the riddle game. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Maya: Riddle one! It's a thing which has teeth but never eats. … Diego: Teeth but never eats… a comb! For your hair! … Maya: Correct! Riddle two: it's a place where the books live. … Diego: The library. Too easy! … Maya: Riddle three: a person who works when everyone sleeps. … Diego: Hmm… a baker! They make bread at night. … Maya: Excellent! Last one, the hardest. A thing which gets bigger when you take more away from it. … Diego: What? Bigger when you take away… A HOLE! … Maya: Champion of riddles! Your prize is… inventing the next four riddles.
